question: Describe the role of redox reactions and ATP in fermentation.
raw: O1: [S1] Fermentation involves redox reactions where organic molecules (such as glucose or sugars) are catabolized, and their electrons are transferred to other organic molecules (cofactors, coenzymes, etc.). This process harnesses the redox potential of the reactants to produce adenosine triphosphate (ATP) and organic end products.
